title: Dawning’s ‘Want That’ turns desire into a song of modern consumption
htmlContent: Dawning's latest single, "Want That," takes listeners on a captivating journey through the vibrant world of electronic pop, where desire meets the realities of our consumer driven society. The song is filled with lush, shimmering sounds that create an enchanting atmosphere, offering personal insight and a commentary on our obsession with wanting and needing more in a world of excess. Dawning's production pulls you into a soundscape where the weight of our cravings is felt alongside the catchy rhythm. "Want That" reflects on what our culture of consumption means, especially in light of global climate change. Each musical element poses a thought-provoking question of what happens when our desires never seem to end. How do we pay the price for wanting more than we truly need? https://open.spotify.com/album/6m8cHIcwoehT6hpRmpb78B Dawning skillfully blends sound and meaning in a way that resonates deeply. "Want That" entices listeners with its captivating sound while encouraging us to think more critically about our desires and their consequences. Follow on: Instagram
